C193.name: Micheweni District
C193.documented: large waves, strong winds, heavy rain, boat accidents, and cholera

area.en: Micheweni: dry north and fishing villages
area.sw: Micheweni: kaskazini kame na vijiji vya wavuvi

risk.en: This area is the driest part of Pemba, where water shortages and dry spells hit households and crops, and fishers face rough seas.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni sehemu kame zaidi ya Pemba, ambapo uhaba wa maji na vipindi vya ukavu huathiri kaya na mazao, na wavuvi hukabiliwa na bahari chafu.

advice.en: For those living and fishing here, it helps to harvest and store rainwater, plant drought-tolerant crops and stay ashore in strong winds. What raises the risk and to the loss: letting the tanks run dry before the dry season, drawing from the few wells for livestock and households alike, relying on one crop, and going out in loaded boats when the wind is rising. Agree early, as a household and a shehia, where water and food will come from when the dry spell runs long, and know the sheltered landing boats will run to and the higher ground inland your village will move to when a storm-tide warning is given. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kuvua hapa, ni vyema kuvuna na kuhifadhi maji ya mvua, kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame na kubaki ufukweni upepo mkali unapovuma. Kinachoongeza hatari na hasara: kuacha matanki yakauke kabla ya kiangazi, kuchota kwenye visima vichache kwa mifugo na kaya sawa, kutegemea zao moja, na kutoka baharini kwa vyombo vilivyojaa upepo unapopanda. Kubalianeni mapema, kama kaya na shehia, maji na chakula vitatoka wapi kiangazi kikirefuka, na fahamu mwalo uliokingwa ambao vyombo vitakimbilia na eneo la juu la ndani ambalo kijiji chenu kitahamia tahadhari ya mawimbi ya dhoruba inapotolewa. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C192.name: Wete District
C192.documented: coastal floods, large waves, heavy rain, and boat accidents

area.en: Wete: hilly clove farms and harbour
area.sw: Wete: mashamba ya karafuu ya milimani na bandari

risk.en: This area has hilly clove farms where heavy rain erodes slopes and floods valleys, and a harbour exposed to storm tides.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mashamba ya karafuu ya milimani ambapo mvua kubwa humomonyoa miteremko na kufurika mabonde, na bandari inayoathiriwa na mawimbi makubwa.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep trees on slopes, build away from valley floors and keep boats secured before storms. What raises the risk: clearing the clove slopes bare, cutting into the slope behind a house, building on the valley floors, and leaving boats and goods on the harbour front when strong winds are forecast. Agree with neighbours on a safe place off the slope and above the valley, and move there when cracks open or the valley stream rises; when a strong-wind warning is given, secure or lift the boats before the wind arrives. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kuacha miti kwenye miteremko, kujenga mbali na sakafu za mabonde na kufunga vyombo imara kabla ya dhoruba. Kinachoongeza hatari: kusafisha miteremko ya mikarafuu hadi kuwa tupu, kuchimba mteremko nyuma ya nyumba, kujenga kwenye sakafu za mabonde, na kuacha vyombo na bidhaa bandarini upepo mkali unapotabiriwa. Kubalianeni na majirani eneo salama nje ya mteremko na juu ya bonde, na hamieni huko nyufa zikifunguka au kijito cha bondeni kikipanda; tahadhari ya upepo mkali ikitolewa, fungeni au pandisheni vyombo kabla upepo haujafika. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
